name: melted-plastic-lachapelle
keep: KEEP — the making of the image, copy exactly:

· PHOTOGRAPHY: a hyperreal, glossy, maximalist staged studio tableau in the David-LaChapelle vein — a single sharp real subject set inside a dense crowd of figures all sculpted from melting, dripping, wet plastic / resin / candle wax.
· GROUND: a flat bright blue studio sky at the top meeting a floor of pooled, oozing, glossy pastel plastic goo that everything sinks into.
· LIGHT: bright even high-key studio light, hard wet specular highlights skating across every glossy plastic surface, minimal shadow.
· PALETTE: bubblegum pink, pastel baby-blue, cream and buttercream yellow, with one deep glossy navy / oxblood accent and hot fuchsia blade shapes.
· SIGNATURE TREATMENT: everything but the hero subject rendered as slick melting toy plastic — smeared, molten, candy-coloured — with neon pink lance / sword forms slashing across the frame.
· MOOD: chaotic, camp, surreal, saccharine-yet-violent spectacle.
· GRAIN: clean crisp high-resolution capture, deep saturation, plastic sheen over the whole frame.
· No readable text, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark anywhere.
